newsitem.title: BURMA: Bangladesh minister to raise border issue in Burma.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh minister to raise border issue in Burma.

text.p: Bangladesh Foreign Minister Abdus Samad Azad met senior Burmese officials on Wednesday and planned to discuss issues related to the border shared by the countries, officials said.

Burmese Foreign Minister Ohn Gyaw told Reuters late on Tuesday that his counterpart was in Rangoon for a three-day visit to discuss border trade, the repatriation of Burmese Moslems and the designation of sea boundaries.
Azad was to meet one of the most powerful leaders of the military government, Lieutenant General Khin Nyunt, on Wednesday.

About 40,000 Burmese Moslems, called Rohingyas, are in Bangladeshi refugee camps awaiting repatriation. They were among more than 250,000 Rohingyas who fled to Bangladesh from western Burma in 1992 to escape what they said was persecution by the military junta.
Azad's visit comes amid strained relations between the neighbours. Dhaka said five people had been killed and several others wounded by landmines planted by Burmese troops on the border last week.
